recitations.title: 晚饭后共读：把答应的小事做好
周末家庭共读：一张借用纸条
爷爷讲的守信故事：补充出处中
从每天节约一张纸开始

promises.text: 每周日一起整理借阅的书，按时归还；做不到的事提前告诉家人。
晚饭时放下手机，认真听家人讲完一天的经历，再一起商量明天的安排。

stories.title: 红色家书 · 责任与守信
stories.text: 这是一则虚构的红色家风故事。老党员在家书里写道，答应群众的事，要认真做到。孙女读完信，决定从身边的小事尽责。

stories.title: A red family letter: responsibility and trust
stories.text: An original fictional story. In a family letter, a veteran Party member wrote: keep the promises you make to the community. After reading it, a granddaughter chose to take responsibility through small acts of service.

stories.title: 清廉，始于日常的选择
stories.text: 这是一则原创清廉故事。孩子问，家里的纸能用单位的吗？父亲说，公家的东西要留给公事。清廉，始于日常的选择。

stories.title: Integrity in everyday choices
stories.text: An original story about integrity. A child asked if they could bring paper home from the office. The parent said, public supplies are for public work. Integrity begins with everyday choices.
